resources.string: Save text marked sensitive by its source app. Turning this off removes saved sensitive text and its Undo.
Remove timed sensitive text after the chosen duration or a reboot. Copying it again does not extend its current timer.
Choose how long to keep sensitive text. A shorter duration can shorten active timers; a longer one applies to new text.
Enter a duration from 1 to 1,440 minutes.
Sensitive text will stay in history until you delete it or turn capture off. Existing timers will be removed. Encryption protects stored files, but text remains readable while using the app.
